description: Your resident's day at home, one action at a time: chore (one chore, now: a few real minutes, and a few coins when it was due), daily_visit (the once-a-day visit: the chores that are due go on the plan, and you hear what happened while away), hobby (take up a hobby, or work: a sitting with the one you have), aim (a small project of your own, or done to mark one done), wait (stay where you are, some minutes or for a neighbour, so whoever comes finds you), start_machine (set a machine at home going). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. check chores, check plan and check aims say what's there first; let_go cancel_steps takes steps off the plan. Nothing here costs coins, and nothing is taken away.

action.description: What to do: chore, daily_visit, hobby, aim, wait or start_machine.

done.description: Optional, aim: the number of an aim to mark done (check aims numbers them).

for.description: Optional, wait: a neighbour's name, like Mira, to wait for (half an hour at most).

hobby.description: Optional, hobby: the hobby to take up.

machine.description: start_machine: the machine at home, like robot mower.

minutes.description: Optional, wait: how long, in minutes, up to 60. Left out, half an hour.

words.description: Optional, aim: the aim, a small project in a line, like grow five kinds of flower.

work.description: Optional, hobby: true for a sitting with the hobby you have, which moves it on.

name: day
title: The day's work
